text: NHC, Saudi Arabia's National Housing Company, was established in 2016 as the investment arm of the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing; in 2020 its ownership was transferred to the Saudi state.
short: NHC's ownership was transferred to the Saudi state in 2020.

source.name: Saudipedia (Saudi Ministry of Media): The National Housing Company (NHC)
source.quote: In 2020, after its business grew, the company's ownership was transferred to the state.
